normal_mode_usb_exploration.source_evidence: OpenRTX vcom is used by XMODEM external-flash backup/restore and M17 demodulator logging; no stock text shell or live host-control command protocol found

info_screen_observations: VHF range 136-174 and UHF range 400-480 visible

xmodem_backup_probe.source_findings: Backup/Restore screens exist in OpenRTX default UI code but are not present in the main menu_items array for the built UI; the backup screen would require PTT to start transfer if reached
xmodem_backup_probe.interpretation: host receiver is ready, but the current flashed UI does not expose a safe reachable Backup menu path

receive_only_observations.source_radio: Quansheng UV-K5 V2 F4HWN custom scrambler build
receive_only_observations.receiver: TYT MD-UV380 running OpenRTX ADHR receive-only patch
receive_only_observations.result: RSSI/signal strength rises sharply on Quansheng transmission, but green RX/audio/speaker does not open
receive_only_observations.conclusion: RF receive/tuning sees the carrier; audio does not open because receiver is in M17 digital mode while source is analog FM. Switch TYT to FM/NFM before repeating.

receive_only_observations.source_radio: Quansheng UV-K5 V2 F4HWN custom scrambler build
receive_only_observations.receiver: TYT MD-UV380 running OpenRTX ADHR receive-only patch
receive_only_observations.result: user reports same no-audio behavior, but green RX indicator/button stays on continuously
receive_only_observations.conclusion: NFM mode is selected, but squelch is likely held open by too-low SQL/noise/RSSI threshold; raise SQL until green is off with no signal, then repeat Quansheng carrier test

receive_only_observations.source_radio: Quansheng UV-K5 V2 F4HWN custom scrambler build
receive_only_observations.source_mode: analog FM/NFM, short user-operated test transmission
receive_only_observations.receiver: TYT MD-UV380 running OpenRTX ADHR receive-only patch
receive_only_observations.receiver_settings: CTCSS disabled; SQL raised until RX indicator is closed with no signal
receive_only_observations.result: user reports Quansheng transmission opens the TYT speaker/audio path
receive_only_observations.conclusion: VHF analog NFM receive path is confirmed on the flashed receive-only OpenRTX build. Earlier no-audio behavior was settings-related, not a cable or RF-front-end failure.

receive_only_observations.source_radio: Quansheng UV-K5 V2 F4HWN custom scrambler build
receive_only_observations.source_mode: CH3 PVT-U1 analog NFM, scrambler off, short user-operated test transmission
receive_only_observations.receiver: TYT MD-UV380 running OpenRTX ADHR receive-only patch
receive_only_observations.receiver_settings: CTCSS disabled; SQL not held open by background noise
receive_only_observations.result: user reports the UHF receive test works
receive_only_observations.conclusion: UHF analog NFM receive path is also confirmed for the current Quansheng/TYT bench pair. This is receive-only evidence and does not validate TYT transmit.
